limitations.test_scope: The reference-v2 test set has previously been opened; this is an exploratory common-data comparison, not a fresh blinded confirmation.
limitations.replication: Three training seeds; four correlated conditions and the same 128 initial states are not independent replications.
limitations.capacity: OSG lambda pairs match architecture and initialization. Cross-family comparisons do not establish capacity matching.
limitations.budget: 100 epochs and matched paired sample exposure; network calls and wall time differ. No convergence claim.
limitations.objective: The DUE-style (fit + lambda * GDSG)/(1 + lambda) changes loss scaling as well as adding regularization.
limitations.structure: Prediction accuracy, composition consistency, and sampled physical diagnostics are separate. No composition ratio uses zero as denominator.
limitations.external_hashes: Unprovided cache/protocol/source files have matching recorded digests only; external_input_verification identifies byte-level checks.

separate_cpu_validation_replay_audit.scope: All three seeds / 18 selected validation replays / 36 checkpoints. No new training or test/rollout prediction. This audit certifies artifact consistency and validation replay, not scientific superiority or independently replayed test metrics.
separate_cpu_validation_replay_audit.validation_method: Frozen runner.validation_mse on all 50 validation initial states at .025/.05/.075/.1 per model. Physical state MSE; float32 predictions and float64 error accumulation. CPU/CUDA tolerance fixed before replay: abs(cpu-recorded) <= 1e-10 + 1e-5*abs(recorded). Test arrays are read only by cache integrity validation; no test prediction is generated.
